title: DAgger twins confirmed at campaign seeds 11 and 31: chosen net2 and neto2 arms, 11 policies
description: exp-dagger-twins-iter-val-256 chose each DAgger arm's iteration on the validation links at campaign seed 21, by the mean over its three training seeds on the five families: r25-means after iteration 19, r26-u0.25 after iteration 39, r26-u0.375 after iteration 59. r25-means is round 25's net2 on net1 v9 reading the means (exp-net2-r25-v9-249); r26-u0.25 and r26-u0.375 are round 26's neto2 on neto1 v2 with the rule at that u as teacher (exp-neto2-r26-v2-254). This run confirms those choices on fresh validation episodes at campaign seeds 11 and 31, every training seed of each chosen arm beside BBRv3 and, as reference lines only, the rule on net1 v9 at u = 0.25 (rule-v9) and on neto1 v2 at u = 0.375 (rule-v2), on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies. Nothing is chosen here; the test run follows with the same arms. Validation links only.
prepare: N9="$IN/v9/$(cat "$IN/v9/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N2="$IN/v2/$(cat "$IN/v2/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v9" "$N9" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v2" "$N2" --u 0.375; P=(--policy "rule-v9=$OUT/v9/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v2=$OUT/v2/rule-u0.375.onnx"); for d in r q x; do (cd "$IN/$d" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); done; for f in "$IN"/x/ppo-r25-means-s*-i19.onnx "$IN"/q/ppo-r26-u0.25-s*-i39.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-r26-u0.375-s*-i59.onnx; do n="$(basename "$f" .onnx)"; n="${n#ppo-}"; it="${n##*-}"; b="${n%-*}"; P+=(--policy "${b%-*}-$it-${b##*-}=$f"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 22 ]; for s in 11 31; do mkdir -p "$OUT/s$s"; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT/s$s" val $s $s bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/s$s/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed $s --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/s$s/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/s$s/"; jq -s add "$OUT/s$s/aliases.json" "$OUT/s$s/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/s$s/a.json"; mv "$OUT/s$s/a.json" "$OUT/s$s/aliases.json"; done
run: for c in "$OUT"/s*/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: for s in 11 31; do uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT/s$s" --apart copies-30s --best r25-means-i19 r26-u0.25-i39 r26-u0.375-i59; done; { for s in 11 31; do echo "# Campaign seed $s"; cat "$OUT/s$s/summary.md"; echo; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
